response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman with a solid track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and full-stack development. However, he falls significantly short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ programming, possessing only about 6 months of professional C++ experience. Furthermore, his background leans heavily toward web, application, and product development rather than the deep, low-level cloud compute infrastructure and hardware architecture required for this specific role.
strengths: Strong technical leadership and mentoring experience, including organizing workshops and holding Staff-level titles.
Demonstrated ability to own and architect end-to-end systems, such as founding and building the GISCollective platform.
Experience with high-throughput distributed systems and microservices, handling millions of requests per second.
concerns: Severely lacks the minimum required 8 years of C++ programming experience, with only around 6 months listed.
Core expertise is in full-stack web (TypeScript, Node.js) and DLang rather than low-level cloud compute technologies.
Lacks deep professional experience architecting large-scale internal compute platforms or hardware-level infrastructure.
